fields.claim_quote:
Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $n=p_1^{e_1}\cdots p_k^{e_k}$
  be its prime decomposition. The \define{low power abelian group of
    order $n$} is the group\[
    \lowpower n = \bigoplus_{i=1}^k\left(\bigoplus_{j=1}^{e_k} C_{p_i}\right),
    \] where $C_{p_i}$ is the cyclic group of order $p_i$.
fields.explanation: The printed repeated exponent e_k gives C2×C3 at the original n12. Mathlib ZMod additive cyclic groups and Fintype.card prove order6≠12. The intended separate exponents e_i give order12; this is an indexing typo.
fields.flaw: The displayed construction defines a low power abelian group of cardinality n.

0646 | \begin{lem}\label{lem:ratio}
0647 |   Let $\{\waffle_i\mid 1\leq i \leq m_\churro\}$ be the waffles
0648 |   attached to a churro $\churro$, then the metric on $\churro$ given
0649 |   in Definition \ref{defn:churro-metrization} is determined by the
0650 |   collection of \define{clutching ratios of $\churro$}:
0651 |   \[
0652 |     r_{ij}=\frac{\tau_{\strand_i}}{\tau_{\strand_j}}; 1\leq i,j \leq m_\churro.
0653 |   \]
0654 | \end{lem}
0655 | \begin{proof}
0656 |   Once $r_{ij}$ is given, all the $\tau_{\strand_i}$ can be determined
0657 |   as $\mu\alpha_i$ up to a common unknown scaling factor $\mu$, and
0658 |   therefore the average $\tau_{\churrocore}$ also be determined as
0659 |   $\mu\bar\alpha$ up to the same scaling factor $\mu$.  The metric on
0660 |   $\churro$ is given by the ratios
0661 |   $\frac{\tau_\churrocore}{\tau_{\strand_i}}=\frac{\bar\alpha}{\alpha_i}$,
0662 |   which do not depend on $\mu$.
0663 | \end{proof}
